about: When the Anthropic Economic Index data behind exposure.json was observed, per dataset folder, as the publisher states it. Read by src/game/server/aei-evidence.js. A period not stated by the publisher is null: the download date (exposure.json source.downloadedAt) is never an observation date.

release_2025_03_27.definition: Per O*NET task, the automation share of the five collaboration patterns: (directive + feedback loop) / (directive + feedback loop + task iteration + validation + learning); computed by src/data/scripts/build_aei_periods.py into data/ai-exposure/periods.json

text.zh: Claude 3.7 Sonnet 发布后的 11 天（约 2025 年 2 月至 3 月，发布方没有写确切日期）
text.en: The 11 days after the launch of Claude 3.7 Sonnet (about February to March 2025; the publisher gives no exact dates)
text.ms: 11 hari selepas pelancaran Claude 3.7 Sonnet (kira-kira Februari hingga Mac 2025; penerbit tidak memberi tarikh tepat)

observationPeriod.quote: We reran our previous analysis on data from the 11 days following the launch [...] covering 1 million anonymized Claude.ai Free and Pro conversations.

labor_market_impacts.definition: Per O*NET task, observed use of Claude for the task (penetration, 0-1); per US occupation, observed exposure

periodNote.zh: 这两个文件没有写观测时期。相关报告的注脚说，这个指标用了 2025 年 8 月和 11 月的使用数据，但没有明确说就是这两个文件。
periodNote.en: These files state no observation period. A footnote of the report says the measure uses usage data from August and November 2025, without naming these files.
periodNote.ms: Fail ini tidak menyatakan tempoh pemerhatian. Nota kaki laporan menyatakan ukuran ini menggunakan data penggunaan Ogos dan November 2025, tanpa menamakan fail ini.

labor_market_impacts.quote: We use the previous two Anthropic Economic Index datasets, covering usage from August and November 2025.

release_2025_09_15.definition: Per O*NET task, the automation share of the five collaboration patterns: (directive + feedback loop) / (directive + feedback loop + task iteration + validation + learning); computed by src/data/scripts/build_aei_periods.py into data/ai-exposure/periods.json

observationPeriod.quote: date_start 2025-08-04, date_end 2025-08-11 (columns of the file itself)

comparability.zh: 和 2025-03-27 版一样是 Claude.ai 免费和 Pro 用户、同样的合作模式定义；但分析的模型换了（数据集说明写的是 Sonnet 4，之前是 Claude 3.7 Sonnet），没有归类的对话改为 none 和 not_classified 两类，计算时和之前的 filtered 一样排除。
comparability.en: Like release_2025_03_27: Claude.ai Free and Pro, the same collaboration patterns; but the model changed (the dataset card names Sonnet 4, Claude 3.7 Sonnet before), and unclassified conversations are now 'none' and 'not_classified', left out like 'filtered' before.
comparability.ms: Seperti release_2025_03_27: Claude.ai Free dan Pro, corak kerjasama yang sama; tetapi model berubah (kad set data menamakan Sonnet 4, sebelum ini Claude 3.7 Sonnet), dan perbualan tanpa kelas kini 'none' dan 'not_classified', dikecualikan seperti 'filtered' sebelum ini.

classificationCriteria.scope: target-career tasks present in every release (data/ai-exposure/periods.json)
classificationCriteria.setBy: team (user decision, prompt 07), before the classification was computed
classificationCriteria.note: A change of the automation share of 5 percentage points or more between the first and the last release reads as extreme; otherwise moderate. Careers with fewer paired tasks than minimumPairedTasks (the fewTasks threshold) are insufficient evidence.
